The main takeaway from our work is that

the classical continuity principle for CSMs, which asserts the existence of a continuous function from X with dense image in ℝ, is constructively equivalent to the existence of a sequentially continuous function with dense image in ℕ.
we are able to prove continuity principles for functions from Baire space to ℝ and ℤ that are stronger than the classical principles.
